prompts.cocktail: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW transparent 1536x1024 chunky PIXEL GAME wardrobe atlas. Reference image defines EXACT coarse square pixels, tiny dot eyes/red mouth, detached heads above headless bodies, proportions. Keep two disconnected rows / three equal columns centered x256,768,1280. Top row heads/hair y20..580 with face chin near y360; bottom row separate HEADLESS bodies y655..1004. Arms resting beside body. No scene, microphone, text, shadows or glow. True transparent background. Based on SeeYa 2006 Concert 7080 Cocktail Love stage: LEFT BORAM, dark brown side swept bangs and many long thin braids threaded with light blue ribbons, large turquoise round hoop earrings. Body blue strapless fitted top, long white narrow scarf draped around neck, silver/blue waist belt, white flared trousers, white heels, small blue arm bangle. CENTER GYURI, long black wavy hair side part no straight bangs, small silver drop earrings. Body white off-shoulder loose long blouse sleeves, short dark navy waistcoat over royal blue long tunic, broad white waist belt, slim white long trousers and white heels. RIGHT YEONJI long chestnut brown layered hair with straight bangs and wavy ends, small silver earrings. Body royal blue short-sleeve bolero over blue-and-white horizontal stripe tank top, wide white decorated hip belt over blue long hem, white flared trousers and white heels. Preserve head/body proportions and exact pixel rendering from reference. Do NOT assemble heads and bodies, do NOT recolor existing dresses: design these new trouser silhouettes.
prompts.hotgirl: Use case: stylized-concept. NEW transparent 1536x1024 chunky PIXEL GAME wardrobe atlas. Reference defines exact coarse square pixel style, dot eyes, little red mouth, thick stepped dark outlines, two rows of detachable parts. THREE heads at x256,768,1280 y20..580, face chins near y360. THREE separate headless bodies y655..1004 same centers, small exposed neck, arms down. Do NOT assemble heads and bodies. Based on SeeYa HOT GIRL KBS Music Bank October 3, 2008 pink stage styling. Fixed left BORAM: shoulder-length curled-under chestnut brown hair with side fringe, red headband, small colorful hoop earrings. Body pale pink sleeveless top with large red white-polka-dot bow at chest, bright yellow broad waist belt, magenta dotted short pleated skirt, bare legs and black low ankle stage shoes. Black headphones with green/yellow trim rest around neck; colorful bangles on one wrist. Center GYURI: short dark brown side-part bob flipped out at ends, tiny tilted silver top hat with purple band and feather on right of image; small silver hoops. Body hot pink zip hoodie open over white tank, matching hot-pink sporty pleated mini skirt with white hem, pink headphones with yellow star on earcup around neck, white knee-high socks with pink stripes and white shoes. Right YEONJI: long dark brown straight layered hair with straight bangs, little silver bow/tiara clip; silver small earrings. Body pink-white check three-quarter sleeve shirt under pale pink short bib overalls/romper, cinched tie waist, pink headphones with green star earcup around neck, pale grey calf-high boots. Garment details simplified to few crisp blocks. Same proportions as reference. True alpha transparency, NO text/logos, microphones, stage, shadow or glow. Pixel costume reinterpretation not realistic portrait.
